question: Can two scalar reader-response coefficients be predicted from the exact source-resolved block8H1 writer vector, completing a non-replay low-rank response program?
novelty: The response-rank screen uses oracle row coefficients projected from captured downstream responses. No prior test predicts both coefficients from the upstream causal write and installs only the predicted rank-one responses.

frozen_design.population: fresh A1 even rows fit; fresh A1 odd rows held out; all fresh A2 rows transfer; P and C are same-answer controls
frozen_design.writer_vector: sum over the two subject-onset destinations of the exact donor-minus-base block8H1 cue source terms; direct per-destination reconstruction is separately checked
frozen_design.reader_axes: separate uncentered rank-one SVD axes for block9 H1/H4 and block11 H3 fitted on A1-even rows
frozen_design.coefficient_model: for each reader, one affine least-squares map from the scalar projection onto the A1-even writer rank-one axis to the scalar projection onto that reader axis

predictions.pred_a_exact_writer_vector: direct per-destination source-term reconstruction equals the established fixed-source writer at <=1e-4 scored-logit max error on every split
predictions.pred_b_coefficient_prediction: both reader coefficient correlations have absolute r>=0.75 on heldout A1 and >=0.50 on A2
predictions.pred_c_predicted_program_material: predicted program is donorward on >=0.75 of rows and retains >=0.60 of full response on heldout A1 and A2
predictions.pred_d_prediction_beats_intercept: predicted program exceeds intercept-only recovery by >=0.15 of full response on both splits
predictions.pred_e_controls_selective: predicted-program absolute normalized P and C effects <=0.20
predictions.pred_f_price_exact: 47 forwards, 1216 examples, 240 unique answer-changing arm-row records, four fitted scalars, 512 stored axis coordinates, zero backwards/updates

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, exact writer reconstruction, coverage, finiteness, or price fails
terminal_rules.wrong_predictor: oracle rank-one response remains material but coefficient correlation or predicted execution fails
terminal_rules.null: predicted coefficients correlate but fail to execute material behavior

interpretation_limits: This is a four-scalar affine compiler over fixed empirical axes, not yet a symbolic derivation of attention weights.
A1-to-A2 transfer is the decisive protection against memorizing the fit rows.
The two reader axes remain separate live-boundary objects.
